estados.title: Status filter
estados.description: One or more procedure statuses to search. "Vigente" (open/in force) is the closest equivalent to "currently open tenders".

keyword.title: Keyword (object/title contains)
keyword.description: Optional free-text keyword (Spanish), matched against the procurement object/title. Leave empty to browse all matching the status filter.

numero.title: Procedure number contains
numero.description: Optional. Filters to a specific procedure/tender number (e.g. "16/2026").

institucion.title: Institution name contains
institucion.description: Optional. Filters to one government institution -- a case-insensitive substring match against SISCAE's own institution list (e.g. "ENACAL" or "Alcaldia"). Leave empty to search all institutions.

departamento.title: Department (region) contains
departamento.description: Optional. Filters to one of Nicaragua's departments/regions -- a case-insensitive substring match (e.g. "Managua", "Leon"). Leave empty to search all departments.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many procedures this run returns. SISCAE's own search form supports up to 100 results per request (this actor requests the smallest page size -- 10/25/50/100 -- that covers your maxResults); no further pagination beyond 100 was confirmed working during recon.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. This target was confirmed reachable directly from Apify's plain datacenter IP during development (no Residential/country-pinned proxy was needed, unlike some other Latin American targets in this collection) -- Residential is offered here as a safety default in case that changes.
